data.narrative:
Speedata is a Series B semiconductor company that has raised $114M to date, operating within a competitive frontier-chip landscape. The valuation comp universe comprises 8 private peers at various stages (SambaNova Systems at $11.0B Series A, Etched at $5.0B Series C, d-Matrix at $2.0B Series C, Positron AI at $1.0B Series B, and DEEPX at $529M Series C) plus 3 public semiconductor anchors (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) with a median price-to-sales multiple of 21.5x.

Two triangulation methods were applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to $114M total raised as a proxy valuation and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage advancement, implies $217M. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies yielded a median valuation of $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M to $11.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable due to the absence of revenue data for the target.

The two methods produced a wide dispersion: stage-progression yielded $217M while peer-median indicated $2.0B. The triangulated range is $184M (low), $1.1B (median), to $2.3B (high). Key uncertainties include Speedata's revenue trajectory and capital efficiency relative to peers, particularly Positron AI (the closest stage match at $1.0B), and whether the broad peer range reflects genuine market differentiation or valuation volatility in early-stage chip design.
